cohort: Women with early-stage cervical cancer (FIGO 2018 stage 1B1, squamous cell carcinoma, grade II tumors) who underwent either laparoscopic assisted vaginal radical trachelectomy or radical hysterectomy along with sentinel or systemic pelvic lymphadenectomy.
finding: Patients undergoing radical hysterectomy showed worse total pelvic scores on postoperative assessment compared with baseline and experienced more urinary dysfunction in the early postoperative phase than those undergoing laparoscopic assisted vaginal radical trachelectomy.
